facts.fact: Cassava Technologies says it is deploying its NVIDIA-powered AI Factory in South Africa, offering GPU-as-a-service and AI APIs as local compute, and the CSIR's NICIS centre manager speaks of the launch of the first Cassava AI Factory in the country.
Cassava Technologies says its AI Factory in South Africa, powered by NVIDIA, provides local GPUaaS and AIaaS/API compute.

Zindi's CEO says Cassava AI Factory compute is helping the Zindi developer community build AI solutions, and the CSIR's NICIS centre manager says it lets the CSIR extend partnership to South African research communities.
